source_truth.role_note: Producer-only: emits a spatial/operational evidence-envelope export that the parent hub (thehub-pr) discovers, validates, and aggregates. Cross-producer correlation is performed by thehub-pr and the downstream PRIIS consumer, not here. The former in-repo query-hub is retired under docs/legacy/federation/hub/ (see docs/REPO_BOUNDARY.md).

producer_side.ppp_geometry_lane: readiness/ppp_geometry.py resolves moneysweep-pr concession projects from a municipality to a WGS84 point using configs/airport_registry.yaml, and scripts/federation_export.py emits the result as anchored canonical observations. Unmatched projects stay in the geocode queue rather than receiving a municipality-centroid guess. Skipped when no moneysweep-pr sibling checkout is present.

hub_callable_commands.setup: python -m pip install uv && uv pip install --system -e .[airspace,earthgpt,server,dev]

resolved_conditions: Z2 geometry projection complete: scripts/federation_export.py projects representative WGS84 location onto canonical record entities for observations, events, and tracks when Point geometry or LineString path data exists.

real (non-synthetic) rows exist: scripts/build_real_spatial_streams.py emits 10 real observations + 2 real sources from committed data (Isabela site record + PR airport registry); build+validate --mode production passes (docs/federation_readiness.md gate)
the parent hub (thehub-pr) validated this producer's canonical package: hub validate-package -> VALID; hub validate-federation classifies spiderweb-pr as declared_not_live with package_valid=true

operator approved the first real production package (2026-07-03 'every follow-up' sweep): ready_for_hub_live_execution flipped true; corpus is small-but-real (1 structure sighting + 9 airport reference locations) and grows with the intake lane

PPP geometry lane: spiderweb resolves moneysweep-pr's municipality-only concession projects to real points and returns them as canonical observations, so thehub-pr's correlate_observations can join a public-money project to a place (hub validate-package -> VALID).
